single_agent.description: One camera grounds the instruction and commits. No gate.

confidence_gate.description: One camera, blocking when its own confidence < tau.

coact.description: Two viewpoints must localise the referent to within 5 cm of the same point before anything moves.

coact_after_correction.description: CoAct, then one spoken correction on every block.

correction.description: After a block the human names the plate; both agents re-ground.
